cues.en: It's a show tune, but show ain't been written for it yet

cues.zh: 我们来看看Tony Jerome和乐队能不能帮我搞定它，赶紧给我理清楚。
cues.en: We gonna see if Tony Jerome and the band can maybe work it out for me, straighten me out right quick.

cues.zh: 目前我还挺喜欢的，伙计
cues.en: I like it so far man

cues.zh: 是啊
cues.en: Yeah

cues.zh: 来吧，我们走
cues.en: Come on, let's go

cues.zh: 欢迎来到联蛇国，盗贼之地，奴隶之家
cues.en: Welcome to the United Snakes, Land of the Thief, Home of the Slave

cues.zh: 盛大的帝国卫队，美元神圣而自豪，咱们来真的吧，来吧。
cues.en: grand imperial guard where the dollar is sacred and proud let's do this s** for real, come on now.

cues.zh: 烟雾和镜子，星条旗，
cues.en: Smoke and mirrors stripes and stars,

cues.zh: 以神之名渴望十字架。
cues.en: yearnin' for the cross in the name of God.

cues.zh: 流血、种族灭绝、强奸和欺诈写进了法律条文里，天哪。
cues.en: Bloodshed genocide rape and fraud written into the pages of the law, good lord.

cues.zh: 寒冷大陆上的钥匙儿童，某天离家出走，开始胡作非为。
cues.en: The cold continent latchkey child ran away one day and started acting foul.

cues.zh: 野兽之国的国王，爸爸很骄傲，因为罗马帝国已经传下来了。
cues.en: King of where the wild things are, daddy's proud 'cause the Roman empire done passed it down.

cues.zh: 输入了一支受尽折磨的劳动力，伤口从未愈合，诅咒从未摆脱。
cues.en: Imported and tortured a workforce that never healed the wounds or shook the curse off.

cues.zh: 如今，长大的歌利亚国度公开选拔大卫的角色。
cues.en: Now the grown up Goliath Nation holding open auditions for the part of David.

cues.zh: 你能感受到吗？什么都救不了你。你质疑统治，就会被冲进来锁链加身。
cues.en: Can you feel? Nothing can save you. You question the reign you get rushed in and chained up.

cues.zh: 拳头举起，但我一定是疯了，因为我想不出哪怕一个能改变的办法。
cues.en: Fist raised but I must be insane 'cause I can't figure a single damn way to change.

cues.zh: 欢迎来到联合蛇国，窃贼之地，奴隶之家
cues.en: Welcome to the United Snakes, Land of the Thief, Home of the Slave

cues.zh: 那宏伟的帝国卫队，美元神圣，权力即上帝。
cues.en: the grand imperial guard where the dollar is sacred and power is God.

cues.zh: 欢迎来到联合蛇国，窃贼之地，奴隶之家，那宏伟的帝国卫队，美元神圣，权力即上帝。
cues.en: Welcome to the United Snakes, Land of the Thief, Home of the Slave, the grand imperial guard where the dollar is sacred and power is God.

cues.zh: 所有人都必须向肥胖懒惰者低头。
cues.en: All must bow to the fat and lazy.

cues.zh: “那些f**服从了我，为什么还恨我？”我？离世界上最卑劣的奴隶贸易才两代人
cues.en: "The f** obeyed me and why do they hate me?" Who me? Only two generations away from the world's most despicable slavery trade

cues.zh: 开创了那么多贬低人的方式，至今都无法改变。
cues.en: Pioneered so many ways to degrade a human being that it can't be changed to this day.

cues.zh: 积习难改，深植于我们的思维方式，我们不再需要用锁链来奴役人。
cues.en: Legacy so ingrained in the way that we think, we no longer need chains to be slaves.

cues.zh: 天哪，奴隶们的遭遇真是可悲。
cues.en: Lord, it's a shame for the slaves.

cues.zh: 监工们甚至一路上还强奸妇女。
cues.en: The overseers even got a raped along the way.

cues.zh: 因为孩子们无法逃脱痛苦，他们生来就带着麻痹，血管里流淌着仇恨
cues.en: 'Cause the children can't escape from the pain and they born with a palsy and there's hatred in their veins

cues.zh: 试图把一个人的灵魂从他身上分离，你只会让他更强大，同时失去自己的灵魂。
cues.en: Try and separate a man from his soul, you only strengthen him and lose your own.

cues.zh: 但如果那个混蛋走近王座，就开枪打死他。提醒他这是我的家。现在我走了。
cues.en: But shoot that f** if he walk near the throne. Remind him that this is my home. Now I'm gone.

cues.zh: 欢迎来到联合蛇国，窃贼之地，奴隶之家，伟大的帝国卫队，在那里美元神圣不可侵犯，权力就是上帝。
cues.en: Welcome to the United Snakes, Land of the Thief, Home of the Slave, the grand imperial guard where the dollar is sacred and power is God.

cues.en: Welcome to the United Snakes, Land of the Thief, Home of the Slave, the grand imperial guard where the dollar is sacred...

cues.zh: 等等，给我来一个，等等。
cues.en: hold on, give me one right here, hold on.

cues.zh: 你不给街角的流浪汉钱
cues.en: You don't give money to the bums

cues.zh: 那些牙龈流着血、举着牌子的人？
cues.en: on the corner with a sign bleeding from their gums?

cues.zh: 你说什么“别支持瘾君子”。你觉得你交的税钱都去哪了？
cues.en: Somethin' about you "don't support a crackhead." What do you think happens to the money from your taxes?

cues.zh: 政府才是那个瘾君子，每周花十亿美元杀人，专杀棕色人种。
cues.en: The government's the addict, with a billion dollar a week kill brown people habit.

cues.zh: 嘿，就算“老板”喊“冲刺时刻”时你不在前线，你照样得回去干。
cues.en: Hey, even if you ain't on the front line when massa yell "crunch time" you're right back at it.

cues.zh: 哥们，看看你是怎么倒着忙活的，年底算算他们扣了你多少。
cues.en: Player, look at how you hustling backwards, at the end of the year add up what they subtracted.

cues.zh: 一年12个月里有3个月的工资花在了那荒唐事上。老兄，这叫悲哀！
cues.en: 3 out of 12 months of your salary paid for that madness. Man that's sadness!

cues.zh: 还剩什么？买台大等离子电视，看看他们让Dan Rather把镜头对准了哪儿。
cues.en: What's left? Get a big ass plasma to see where they made Dan Rather point the damn camera.

cues.zh: 只有批准过的问题才会被回答，现在起立听国歌吧。
cues.en: Only approved questions get answered, now stand your ass up for that National Anthem.
